vb_textbox.text: Think of the game as having two groups. The two groups are (orange, blue, red, pink) and (yellow, brown, purple, green). At a given time, one group will yield higher mushrooms than the other group. The groups swap a few times during the study. Be mindful to whether your group is yielding a high amount of mushrooms (5+) on average, if not then swap to choosing colors in the other group. Do not be sensitive to changing groups. The groups seem to last at least 10 rounds, sometimes going as long as 30. The colors are always presented in the same pairs orange+yellow, blue+brown, red+purple, pink+green. I tried observing 2-3 rounds of low yield baskets before swapping groups and seeing what the other group would yield. If I got continuously high yield baskets, then I stayed in that group, if not then I would return to the other group. Don't forget the most important part is recognizing there are 2 groups (orange, blue, red, pink) and (yellow, brown, purple, green). Focus on identifying which of these two groups has higher yield and choose those colors. Stay alert and have fun. Good Luck!
